newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo Nikkei rises 2% on high-tech share buying.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo Nikkei rises 2% on high-tech share buying.

text.p: Tokyo stocks rallied in late afternoon trade on Wednesday, helped by strength in the communications and high-technology sectors.
The key market index briefly rose by two percent.
Brokers said a rally in Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corp and other issues in the telecommunications sector brightened market sentiment.
High-technology issues also rose, supported by the stable yen/dollar rate and a rally in high-tech stocks on Wall Street.
